claims.statement: Artemis is an ancient Greek goddess of hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Artemis adalah dewi Yunani kuno yang membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak.
claims.quote: is the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, transitions, nature, vegetation, childbirth, care of children, and chastity.

claims.statement: Artemis is Leto and Zeus's daughter and Apollo's twin.
claims.statement_id: Artemis adalah putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo.
claims.quote: Artemis was the daughter of Leto and Zeus, and twin sister of Apollo.

claims.statement: Artemis was said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs.
claims.statement_id: Artemis sering dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa.
claims.quote: She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by an entourage of nymphs.

claims.statement: Artemis's Roman counterpart is Diana.
claims.statement_id: Padanan Artemis dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Diana.
claims.quote: The goddess Diana is her Roman equivalent.

claims.statement: Ancient art commonly shows Artemis as a girl or young woman with a hunting bow and quiver.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni kuno Artemis lazim digambarkan sebagai gadis atau perempuan muda dengan busur dan tabung anak panah.
claims.quote: In ancient art Artemis was usually depicted as a girl or young maiden with a hunting bow and quiver of arrows.

claims.statement: Artemis protected girls, young women, and women in childbirth; her famous temple at Ephesus was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
claims.statement_id: Artemis menjadi pelindung gadis, perempuan muda, dan perempuan yang melahirkan; situs pemujaannya yang terkenal adalah Kuil Artemis di Ephesus, salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
claims.quote: Daughter of Zeus and sister of Apollo, Artemis was a patron of girls and young women, and a protectress during childbirth. Artemis was widely worshipped but her most famous cult site was the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.statement: King Agamemnon displeased Artemis by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove; as punishment she becalmed the Achaean fleet, and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease her.
claims.statement_id: Raja Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka karena membunuh seekor rusa di hutan suci; sebagai hukuman Artemis membuat armada Akhaia terjebak tanpa angin, dan hanya pengorbanan Iphigenia yang akan menenangkannya.
claims.quote: The king had displeased the goddess by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove. As punishment, Artemis becalmed the Achaean fleet and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease the goddess into granting a fair wind to Troy.

claims.statement: Agamemnon offered his daughter, but at the last moment the goddess substituted a deer and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.
claims.statement_id: Agamemnon mengorbankan putrinya, tetapi pada saat terakhir sang dewi menggantinya dengan seekor rusa dan menjadikan Iphigenia pendeta di tempat sucinya di Tauris.
claims.quote: Agamemnon duly offered his daughter in sacrifice, but in pity and at the last moment, the goddess substituted a deer for the girl and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis dikatakan membunuh pemburu Orion setelah Orion berusaha memperkosa Artemis sendiri atau salah satu pengikutnya.
claims.quote: The goddess is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

claims.statement: According to Theoi, Orion was the goddess's companion; her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot, and in grief Artemis placed him among the stars as the constellation Orion.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, Orion adalah sahabat sang dewi; Apollon yang cemburu memperdayainya hingga ia membunuh Orion dengan anak panah dari jauh, lalu Artemis menempatkan Orion di antara bintang sebagai rasi Orion.
claims.quote: The handsome giant Orion was a companion of the goddess but her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot. In her grief Artemis placed him amongst the stars as the constellation Orion.

claims.statement: Artemis turned Callisto, one of her entourage, into a bear after she lay with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations of the great and little bear.
claims.statement_id: Artemis mengubah Callisto, salah satu pengiringnya, menjadi beruang setelah Callisto tidur dengan Zeus; Zeus kemudian mengubah Callisto dan putranya Arcas menjadi rasi beruang besar dan beruang kecil.
claims.quote: Artemis turned Callisto, one of the goddess' entourage, into a bear after she had lain with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations the great and little bear

claims.statement: The hunter Actaion was turned into a stag by Artemis, either for boasting he was the greater hunter or (in another version) for spying on her bathing in a forest pool; he was then torn apart by his own 50 hunting dogs.
claims.statement_id: Pemburu Actaion diubah Artemis menjadi rusa jantan, entah karena berani membual bahwa ia pemburu yang lebih hebat, entah (dalam versi lain) karena mengintip Artemis mandi di kolam hutan; ia lalu dicabik oleh 50 anjing pemburunya sendiri.
claims.quote: The hunter Actaion, after he dared boast he was the greater hunter or, in another version, had spied on Artemis while she had bathed in a forest pool, was turned into a stag by the goddess. Actaion was then torn to pieces by his own pack of 50 hunting dogs.

claims.statement: Artemis uses her bow to kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe after Niobe boasted that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.
claims.statement_id: Artemis memakai busurnya untuk membunuh enam (dalam sebagian kisah tujuh) putri Niobe setelah Niobe membual bahwa kemampuannya melahirkan lebih besar daripada Leto.
claims.quote: The goddess uses her bow to mercilessly kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe following her boast that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claims.statement: Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglected to sacrifice to her.
claims.statement_id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai mempersembahkan kurban kepadanya.
claims.quote: Finally, Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city had neglected to sacrifice to the goddess.

claims.statement: When the Aloadai giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis took the form of a doe and ran between them, so that the pair cast their spears, missed, and struck each other dead.
claims.statement_id: Ketika raksasa Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga keduanya melempar tombak, meleset, dan saling membunuh.
claims.quote: When the Aloadai (Aloadae) giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis assumed the form of a doe and raced between them causing the pair to cast their spears, miss, and strike each other dead.

claims.statement: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans in the Trojan War; in a clash between rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, who tore the bow from her hands, beat her, and sent her fleeing to Olympos in tears.
claims.statement_id: Artemis menjadi sekutu ilahi bangsa Troya dalam Perang Troya; dalam bentrokan antarkubu dewa ia berhadapan dengan Hera, yang merebut busurnya, memukulinya, dan membuatnya lari menangis ke Olimpos.
claims.quote: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans during the Trojan War. In a clash between the rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, but the Queen of the Gods tore the bow from her hands, beat her about the head, and sent her fleeing back to Olympos in tears.

claims.statement: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows; she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, a pair of hunting spears, a torch, a lyre, and/or a water-jug.
claims.statement_id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah; ia kadang juga dilengkapi tabung panah, sepasang tombak berburu, obor, lira, dan/atau kendi air.
claims.quote: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows but she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, pair of hunting spears, torch, lyre, and/or water-jug.

claims.statement: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer; she drove a chariot drawn by a pair of deer and was often shown holding or hunting a deer or wearing a deer-skin cape.
claims.statement_id: Hewan suci Artemis adalah rusa; ia mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang rusa dan sering digambarkan memegang atau memburu rusa atau berjubah kulit rusa.
claims.quote: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer. She drove a chariot drawn by a pair of the beasts and was often depicted holding or hunting a deer or with a deer-skin cape draped over her shoulders.

claims.statement: Artemis and Apollon were also bringers of sudden death and disease; Artemis targeted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.
claims.statement_id: Artemis dan Apollon juga dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit; Artemis menyasar perempuan dan anak perempuan, Apollon laki-laki dan anak laki-laki.
claims.quote: Together the two gods were also bringers of sudden death and disease--Artemis targetted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

claims.statement: Supporting the Trojans, Artemis heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mendukung bangsa Troya, Artemis menyembuhkan Aeneas setelah Aeneas dilukai Diomedes.
claims.quote: Supporting the Trojans, she notably heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

claims.statement: Homeric Hymn 27 describes Artemis drawing her golden bow over shadowy hills and windy peaks, rejoicing in the chase, and sending out grievous shafts.
claims.statement_id: Himne Homerik 27 melukiskan Artemis menarik busur emasnya di bukit berbayang dan puncak berangin, bersuka dalam perburuan, dan melepaskan anak panah yang menyakitkan.
claims.quote: Over the shadowy hills and windy peaks she draws her golden bow, rejoicing in the chase, and sends out grievous shafts.

claims.statement: Callimachus's Hymn to Artemis says that for those on whom Artemis looks graciously, the tilled land bears corn abundantly, four-footed livestock prosper, and their prosperity grows.
claims.statement_id: Himne Kallimakhos kepada Artemis menyebut bahwa bagi orang yang dipandang Artemis dengan ramah, ladang berbuah melimpah, ternak berkaki empat berkembang, dan kemakmuran mereka bertambah.
claims.quote: But on whomsoever thou lookest smiling and gracious, for them the tilth bears the corn-ear abundantly, and abundantly prospers the four-footed breed, and abundant waxes their prosperity

claims.statement: The famous temple of Artemis at Ephesus was begun c. 550 BCE; finished after a century of labour, it was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Artemis yang termasyhur di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM; ketika selesai setelah kerja selama seabad, ukurannya hampir dua kali Parthenon di Athena, dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
claims.quote: The famous temple of Artemis at the city (begun c. 550 BCE) was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon when it was finally finished after a century of labour; it was regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.statement: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where she was born in some versions of the myth and assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.
claims.statement_id: Tempat pemujaan Artemis yang penting lainnya mencakup tempat suci di Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, dan pulau Delos, tempat ia lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan membantu kelahiran saudaranya Apollo.
claims.quote: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were the sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where the goddess was born in some myth versions and where she assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

claims.statement: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.
claims.statement_id: Di Brauron, di pantai timur Attika, sebuah situs kuil dan mata air suci dipakai dari abad ke-8 hingga ke-3 SM dan menjadi tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda dan calon pengantin.
claims.quote: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

claims.statement: In ancient Greek art Artemis is most frequently portrayed as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Artemis paling sering digambarkan sebagai gadis pemburu yang cantik dengan tabung panah dan busur, atau sebagai alternatif dengan tombak.
claims.quote: Artemis is most frequently portrayed in ancient Greek art as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.

claims.statement: Early representations emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand; on the handles of the Francois vase (570-565 BCE) she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran awal menekankan peran Artemis sebagai dewi hewan dan menampilkannya bersayap dengan seekor burung atau hewan di tiap tangan; pada gagang Vas Francois (570-565 SM) ia memegang macan tutul dan rusa jantan di satu adegan dan singa di adegan lain.
claims.quote: Early representations also emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand. For example, on the handles of the celebrated Francois vase (570-565 BCE), she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis was born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey) and is Apollo's twin sister.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis lahir di Delos atau Ortygia (dekat Ephesus di Turki bagian barat) dan merupakan saudari kembar Apollo.
claims.quote: Born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey), she is the twin sister of the god Apollo.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, one tradition made Artemis a daughter of Demeter rather than Leto, and an Egyptian story made her the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, with Leto only her nurse.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, satu tradisi menyebut Artemis putri Demeter, bukan Leto, dan menurut kisah Mesir ia putri Dionysus dan Isis, sedangkan Leto hanya pengasuhnya.
claims.quote: Artemis was a daughter of Demeter, and not of Leto, while according to an Egyptian story (Herod. ii. 156) she was the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, and Leto was only her nurse.

claims.statement: The earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B at Pylos.
claims.statement_id: Bentuk nama Artemis yang paling awal terbukti adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam Linear B di Pylos.
claims.quote: the earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are the Mycenaean Greek ... written in Linear B at Pylos.

claims.statement: The etymology of the name "Artemis" remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.
claims.statement_id: Asal-usul nama "Artemis" masih belum pasti, meski berbagai asal telah diusulkan.
claims.quote: The etymology of the name "Artemis" (n., f.) remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

claims.statement: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs, and was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.
claims.statement_id: Artemis adalah dewi kourotrofik (pengasuh anak), pelindung anak-anak terutama anak perempuan serta anak hewan, dan dipuja serta ditakuti sebagai salah satu dewi utama persalinan dan kebidanan bersama Eileithyia dan Hera.
claims.quote: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, being the protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs. She was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, just as Apollo not only destroyed but also averted evils, Artemis at the same time cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, seperti Apollo yang tidak hanya merusak tetapi juga menangkal malapetaka, Artemis pada saat yang sama menyembuhkan dan meringankan penderitaan manusia.
claims.quote: As Apollo was not only a destructive god, but also averted the evils which it was in his power to inflict, so Artemis was at the same time a thea ... that is, she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

claims.statement: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, the Spartans sacrificing a goat to her before an engagement.
claims.statement_id: Di Sparta dan Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon tahun 490 SM) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran; orang Sparta mengorbankan seekor kambing kepadanya sebelum bertempur.
claims.quote: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE), Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, a goat being sacrificed to her before an engagement by the Spartans

claims.statement: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus; her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi kesuburan, Artemis Ephesia sangat dipuja di Ephesus; pemujaannya memuat unsur-unsur dari timur (dipinjam dari dewi seperti Isis, Kibele, dan "Nyonya Para Hewan") dengan lebah, kurma, dan rusa jantan sebagai lambang utama.
claims.quote: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus, near to what many believed was her birthplace, Ortygia. Here, her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, the Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Artemis dari Ephesus adalah dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani bernama sama.
claims.quote: The Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis's special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kekuatan khusus Artemis mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
claims.quote: The goddess Artemis has special powers which include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

claims.statement: In her request to Zeus, the young Artemis asks for eternal virginity, as many names as her brother Apollo, a bow and arrow like his, and the office of bringing light.
claims.statement_id: Dalam permintaannya kepada Zeus, Artemis kecil memohon keperawanan abadi, sebanyak nama saudaranya Apollo, busur dan anak panah seperti milik Apollo, dan tugas membawa cahaya.
claims.quote: Pray give me eternal virginity; as many names as my brother Apollo; a bow and arrow like his; the office of bringing light;

claims.statement: According to Theoi, Kallisto was a handmaiden of the goddess whom Zeus seduced by assuming her form; when Artemis discovered she was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, Kallisto adalah dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus dengan menyamar sebagai dirinya; ketika Artemis tahu gadis itu hamil, ia mengubahnya menjadi beruang dan mengasingkannya ke alam liar.
claims.quote: Kallisto (Callisto) was a handmaiden of the goddess who Zeus seduced by assuming her form. When Artemis discovered the girl was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.

claims.statement: Venus is a Roman goddess associated with love, beauty, desire, sex, fertility, prosperity, and victory.
claims.statement_id: Venus adalah dewi Romawi yang dihubungkan dengan cinta, kecantikan, hasrat, seksualitas, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan.
claims.quote: is a Roman goddess whose functions encompass love, beauty, desire, sex, fertility, prosperity, and victory.

claims.statement: In Roman myth, Venus is the ancestor of the Roman people through her son Aeneas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Venus disebut leluhur bangsa Romawi melalui putranya Aeneas.
claims.quote: In Roman mythology, she was the ancestor of the Roman people through her son, Aeneas, who survived the fall of Troy and fled to Italy.

claims.statement: Romans adapted Aphrodite's myths and imagery for Roman art and Latin literature.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Romawi mengadaptasi kisah dan penggambaran Aphrodite Yunani untuk seni Romawi dan sastra Latin.
claims.quote: The Romans adapted the myths and iconography of her Greek counterpart Aphrodite for Roman art and Latin literature.

claims.statement: World History Encyclopedia calls Venus the Roman goddess of love, sex, beauty, and fertility, counterpart to Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Venus adalah dewi cinta, seksualitas, kecantikan, dan kesuburan Romawi, padanan Aphrodite Yunani.
claims.quote: In Roman mythology, Venus was the goddess of love, sex, beauty, and fertility. She was the Roman counterpart to the Greek goddess Aphrodite.

claims.statement: The source names Vulcan as Venus's husband and Mars as another divine lover.
claims.statement_id: Sumber menyebut Vulcan sebagai suami Venus dan Mars sebagai pasangan ilahi lainnya.
claims.quote: Venus had two main divine lovers: her husband Vulcan (Hephaistos) and Mars (Ares).

claims.statement: The museum describes Venus and her son Cupid as embodiments of love in verse.
claims.statement_id: Museum menyebut Venus dan putranya Cupid sebagai sosok yang mewujudkan cinta dalam syair.
claims.quote: this potent force was often embodied by Venus (the Greek Aphrodite), goddess of love, and her son Cupid (the Greek Eros)

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, the Roman Venus had many abilities beyond the Greek Aphrodite; she was also a goddess of victory, fertility, and even prostitution.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Venus Romawi memiliki lebih banyak wewenang daripada Aphrodite Yunani; ia juga dewi kemenangan, kesuburan, dan bahkan pelacuran.
claims.quote: However, Roman Venus had many abilities beyond the Greek Aphrodite; she was a goddess of victory, fertility, and even prostitution.

claims.statement: There is a myth about the love affair of Venus and Mars and how Vulcan cunningly trapped them in bed with a net.
claims.statement_id: Ada mitos tentang hubungan cinta Venus dan Mars serta cara Vulcan dengan cerdik menjebak mereka di ranjang dengan jaring.
claims.quote: There is a myth concerning Venus' and Mars' love affair and how Vulcan cunningly trapped them in bed with a net.

claims.statement: With Mars, Venus bore Timor (the personification of fear), his twin Metus (the personification of terror), Concordia (the goddess of harmony and concord), and the Cupids, winged love deities who represented different aspects of love.
claims.statement_id: Dengan Mars, Venus melahirkan Timor (personifikasi ketakutan), kembarannya Metus (personifikasi kengerian), Concordia (dewi keselarasan), dan para Cupid, dewa-dewa cinta bersayap yang mewakili berbagai segi cinta.
claims.quote: With Mars, she gave birth to Timor (Phobos) the personification of fear who accompanied his father into battle, his twin Metus (Deimos) the personification of terror, Concordia (Harmonia) the goddess of harmony and concord, and the Cupids (Erotes) who were a collection of winged love deities who represented the different aspects of love.

claims.statement: Venus disguised herself as a Phrygian princess and seduced Anchises; only nine months later did she reveal her divine identity, presenting Anchises with their son Aeneas.
claims.statement_id: Venus menyamar sebagai putri Frigia dan memikat Anchises; baru sembilan bulan kemudian ia mengungkapkan jati diri ilahinya dan menyerahkan putra mereka, Aeneas, kepada Anchises.
claims.quote: She disguised herself as a Phrygian princess and seduced him; it was only nine months later that she revealed her divine identity. She presented Anchises with their son Aeneas.

claims.statement: Venus warned Anchises never to brag about their affair lest Jupiter strike him; Anchises did brag and was crippled by Jupiter's bolt.
claims.statement_id: Venus memperingatkan Anchises agar tidak pernah membual tentang hubungan mereka agar tidak disambar Jupiter; Anchises tetap membual dan lumpuh oleh petir Jupiter.
claims.quote: Venus warned Anchises never to brag about their affair lest he be struck by Jupiter. Unfortunately, Anchises did brag and was crippled by Jupiter's bolt.

claims.statement: According to Virgil's Aeneid, the Trojan Aeneas was fated to found Rome guided by his divine mother Venus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Aeneid karya Virgil, Aeneas dari Troya ditakdirkan mendirikan Roma dengan dibimbing ibunya yang ilahi, Venus.
claims.quote: The Trojan Aeneas, according to Virgil's Aeneid, was fated to found Rome guided by his divine mother Venus.

claims.statement: The first appearance of a temple to Venus was in 295 BCE, to Venus Obsequens (Obedient Venus) on the Aventine Hill by Q. Fabius Gurges.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Venus yang pertama muncul pada 295 SM, yaitu kuil Venus Obsequens (Venus yang Patuh) di Bukit Aventinus oleh Q. Fabius Gurges.
claims.quote: The first appearance of a temple to Venus was in 295 BCE. It was to Venus Obsequens (Obedient Venus) on the Aventine Hill by Q. Fabius Gurges.

claims.statement: In 217 BCE the Sibylline oracle suggested that if Rome (then losing the Second Punic War) could persuade Venus Erycina (Venus of Eryx) to switch allegiance from her Carthaginian Sicilian allies to the Romans, the war would be won.
claims.statement_id: Pada 217 SM orakel Sibila menyarankan bahwa jika Roma (yang saat itu kalah dalam Perang Punik Kedua) dapat membujuk Venus Erycina (Venus dari Eryx) beralih dari sekutu Kartago di Sisilia kepada bangsa Romawi, perang akan dimenangkan.
claims.quote: In 217 BCE, the Sibylline oracle suggested that if Rome (at that time losing the Second Punic War) could persuade Venus Erycina (Venus of Eryx) to change her allegiance from the Carthaginian Silician allies to the Romans, the war would be won.

claims.statement: Rome laid siege to Eryx, offered the goddess a magnificent temple, and took her image back to Rome; this foreign image eventually became Rome's Venus Genetrix (Venus the Mother).
claims.statement_id: Roma mengepung Eryx, menawarkan kuil megah kepada sang dewi, dan membawa arcanya ke Roma; arca asing inilah yang akhirnya menjadi Venus Genetrix (Venus Sang Ibu) milik Roma.
claims.quote: Rome laid siege to Eryx, offered the goddess a magnificent temple, and took her image back to Rome. It was this foreign image that eventually became Rome's Venus Genetrix (Venus the Mother).

claims.statement: In 181 BCE and 114 BCE the temples and cult of Venus Erycina and Venus Verticordia (Venus the changer of hearts) were established for the plebeians.
claims.statement_id: Pada 181 SM dan 114 SM kuil dan pemujaan Venus Erycina dan Venus Verticordia (Venus Pengubah Hati) didirikan untuk kaum plebeian.
claims.quote: but in 181 BCE and 114 BCE, the temples and cult of Venus Erycina and Venus Verticordia (Venus the changer of hearts) were established for the plebeians.

claims.statement: Venus' month was April (the beginning of spring and fertility), when most of her festivals were held; on 1 April the Veneralia was held in honor of Venus Verticordia.
claims.statement_id: Bulan Venus adalah April (awal musim semi dan kesuburan), saat sebagian besar festivalnya diadakan; pada 1 April festival Veneralia diadakan untuk menghormati Venus Verticordia.
claims.quote: Venus' month was April (the beginning of spring and fertility) when most of her festivals were held. On 1 April a festival was held in honor of Venus Verticordia called Veneralia.

claims.statement: Pompey dedicated a temple to Venus Victrix (Venus of Victory) in 55 BCE, Julius Caesar claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix, and Hadrian in 139 CE dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna, making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state.
claims.statement_id: Pompeius mendedikasikan pada 55 SM sebuah kuil bagi Venus Victrix (Venus Sang Pemenang), Julius Caesar mengklaim restu Venus Victrix dan Venus Genetrix, dan Hadrianus pada 139 M mendedikasikan kuil bagi Venus dan Roma Aeterna sehingga Venus menjadi ibu pelindung negara Romawi.
claims.quote: Pompey (who dedicated, in 55 BCE, a temple to Venus Victrix - Venus of Victory), Julius Caesar (who claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix), and Hadrian (who, in 139 CE, dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna - Eternal Rome - making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state).

claims.statement: In Virgil's Aeneid, Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form, the evening star.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Aeneid karya Virgil, Aeneas dituntun ke Latium oleh ibunya dalam wujud langit, yaitu bintang senja.
claims.quote: In Virgil's Aeneid, the Trojan hero Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form: the evening star.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, Venus was often depicted nude, and most sculptures of Venus closely resembled the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Venus sering digambarkan telanjang, dan sebagian besar patungnya sangat mirip dengan Aphrodite dari Knidos dan Venus de Milo.
claims.quote: Venus, due to her natural beauty and sexual nature, was often depicted nude. Most sculptures of Venus resembled a close similarity to the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo.

claims.statement: Venus and Proserpina both became enamored with Adonis and fought until Zeus decided Adonis would spend a third of the year with each and a third wherever he pleased; ultimately he stayed with Venus until killed by a boar.
claims.statement_id: Venus dan Proserpina sama-sama jatuh cinta pada Adonis dan bertengkar hingga Zeus memutuskan Adonis menghabiskan sepertiga tahun dengan masing-masing dan sepertiga sisanya di tempat yang ia suka; akhirnya ia bersama Venus sampai dibunuh babi hutan.
claims.quote: The two goddesses both grew enamored with the mortal, so they fought until Zeus decided that Adonis would spend one-third the year with each of them and a third wherever he pleased. Ultimately, he spent his time with Venus until he was killed by a boar.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, Venus, present at her own festival, understood the meaning of Pygmalion's prayer; as a favourable omen the flame was kindled three times and sent a tapering flame into the air.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, Venus hadir pada festivalnya sendiri dan memahami arti doa Pygmalion; sebagai tanda restu, nyala api menyala tiga kali dan memancarkan lidah api yang runcing ke udara.
claims.quote: The golden Venus, as she herself was present at her own festival, understood what that prayer meant; and as an omen of the Divinity being favourable, thrice was the flame kindled up, and it sent up a tapering flame into the air.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Pygmalion story the goddess was present at the marriage she effected, and after nine full moons the woman bore Paphos, from whom the island took its name.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Pygmalion versi Ovidius, sang dewi hadir pada pernikahan yang ia wujudkan, dan setelah bulan sembilan kali purnama perempuan itu melahirkan Paphos, yang namanya dipakai pulau tersebut.
claims.quote: The Goddess was present at the marriage which she ... effected. And now, the horns of the moon having been nine times gathered into a full orb, she brought forth Paphos; from whom the island derived its name.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as her quiver-bearing son kisses his mother he unwittingly grazes her breast with an arrow, and the wounded goddess pushes her son away.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, ketika putranya yang menyandang tabung panah mencium ibunya, ia tanpa sadar menggores dada sang dewi dengan anak panahnya; sang dewi yang terluka mendorong putranya menjauh.
claims.quote: For, while the boy that wears the quiver is giving kisses to his mother, he unconsciously grazes her breast with a protruding arrow. The Goddess, wounded, pushed away her son with her hand.

claims.statement: Ovid mentions a festival of Venus much celebrated throughout all Cyprus.
claims.statement_id: Ovidius menyebut adanya festival Venus yang dirayakan secara luas di seluruh Siprus.
claims.quote: A festival of Venus, much celebrated throughout all Cyprus

claims.statement: The Latin theonym Venus and the common noun venus ('love, charm') stem from a Proto-Italic form reconstructed as *wenos- ('desire').
claims.statement_id: Nama dewi Latin Venus dan kata benda venus ('cinta, pesona') berasal dari bentuk Proto-Italik yang direkonstruksi sebagai *wenos- ('hasrat').
claims.quote: The Latin theonym Venus and the common noun venus ('love, charm') stem from a Proto-Italic form reconstructed as *wenos- ('desire')

claims.statement: Wikipedia says Cupid and Amor are taken to be different names for the same Roman love-god, the son of Venus, fathered by Mercury, Vulcan or Mars.
claims.statement_id: Wikipedia menyebut Cupid dan Amor sebagai dua nama untuk dewa cinta Romawi yang sama, putra Venus yang ayahnya disebut Merkurius, Vulcan, atau Mars.
claims.quote: Cupid (lust or desire) and Amor (affectionate love) are taken to be different names for the same Roman love-god, the son of Venus, fathered by Mercury, Vulcan or Mars.

claims.statement: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon" and as "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess.
claims.statement_id: Venus pernah digambarkan sebagai mungkin "ciptaan paling orisinal dari panteon Romawi" dan sebagai dewi asli yang "tak terdefinisi jelas dan bersifat menyerap".
claims.quote: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon", and "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess

claims.statement: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor; Venus was central to many religious festivals and revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.
claims.statement_id: Julius Caesar mengklaim Venus sebagai leluhurnya; Venus menjadi pusat banyak festival keagamaan dan dipuja dalam agama Romawi dengan banyak gelar kultus.
claims.quote: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor. Venus was central to many religious festivals, and was revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.

claims.statement: At the close of the Roman Republic some Romans laid claim to Venus's favor and competed for it, for example Sulla, who adopted the name Felix (Latin for lucky) and credited Venus Felix with his divine favor.
claims.statement_id: Pada akhir Republik Romawi, sebagian orang Romawi mengklaim restu Venus dan bersaing merebutnya, misalnya Sulla yang memakai nama Felix (bahasa Latin untuk 'beruntung') dan menisbahkan keberuntungannya kepada Venus Felix.
claims.quote: At the close of the Roman Republic, some Romans laid claim to Venus' favor and competed for it, such as Sulla (adopting the name Felix, Latin for lucky, and accrediting Venus Felix to his divine favor)

claims.statement: Hermes is a Greek Olympian herald of the gods and protector of travelers and merchants.
claims.statement_id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus Yunani, pembawa pesan dewa dan pelindung pelancong serta pedagang.
claims.quote: is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and mythology considered the herald of the gods. He is also widely considered the protector of human heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators.

claims.statement: Hermes serves as a guide of souls to the afterlife.
claims.statement_id: Hermes berperan sebagai pembimbing jiwa menuju alam kematian.
claims.quote: Hermes plays the role of the psychopomp or "soul guide"—a conductor of souls into the afterlife.

claims.statement: Theoi identifies Hermes with flocks, travelers, roads, trade, cunning, heralds, and diplomacy.
claims.statement_id: Theoi menyebut Hermes dewa ternak, pelancong, jalan, perdagangan, kecerdikan, pembawa pesan, dan diplomasi.
claims.quote: HERMES was the Olympian god of herds and flocks, travellers and hospitality, roads and trade, thievery and cunning, heralds and diplomacy, language and writing, athletic contests and gymnasiums, astronomy and astrology.

claims.statement: Hermes is shown as a beardless youth or older bearded man with winged boots and a herald's wand.
claims.statement_id: Hermes digambarkan sebagai pemuda tanpa janggut atau pria tua berjanggut dengan sepatu bersayap dan tongkat pembawa pesan.
claims.quote: Hermes was depicted as either a handsome and athletic, beardless youth or as an older, bearded man, with winged boots and a herald's wand.

claims.statement: World History Encyclopedia calls Hermes the Olympian gods' herald and messenger.
claims.statement_id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hermes pembawa pesan dewa-dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: One of the cleverest and most mischievous of the 12 Olympian gods, Hermes was their herald and messenger.

claims.statement: Romans knew Hermes as Mercury.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Romawi mengenal Hermes sebagai Mercury.
claims.quote: To the Romans, the god was known as Mercury.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, in his position as herald he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries as a guide between the realms of gods and humanity.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kedudukannya sebagai utusan, Hermes menjadi lambang penyeberangan batas sebagai pemandu antara dua alam, dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: In that position, he came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries in his role as a guide between the two realms of gods and humanity.

claims.statement: Hermes is said to have invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice; the latter explains why gamblers loved him.
claims.statement_id: Hermes dikisahkan menciptakan lira, alfabet, dan dadu; yang terakhir menjelaskan mengapa para penjudi memujanya.
claims.quote: He invented the lyre, the alphabet, and dice. The latter explains why the god was beloved by gamblers.

claims.statement: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.
claims.statement_id: Hermes adalah pelindung para gembala dan menciptakan seruling pan yang mereka pakai untuk memanggil kawanan.
claims.quote: Hermes was the patron of shepherds and invented the panpipes they used to call their flock.

claims.statement: With origins as an Arcadian fertility god with a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.
claims.statement_id: Dengan asal-usul sebagai dewa kesuburan Arkadia yang sangat mencintai Peloponnesos, orang Yunani kuno percaya Hermes putra Zeus dan nimfa Maia (putri Titan Atlas) dan lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia.
claims.quote: With origins, then, as an Arcadian fertility god who had a special love for the Peloponnese, the ancient Greeks believed Hermes was the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia (daughter of the Titan Atlas) and that he was born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia.

claims.statement: While still a baby, Hermes stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks with bark shoes to make them hard to track.
claims.statement_id: Ketika masih bayi, Hermes mencuri kawanan 50 ternak suci milik saudara tirinya, Apollo, dari Pieria, dengan cerdik membalik jejak kuku dengan menambahkan sepatu kulit kayu agar sulit dilacak.
claims.quote: While still a baby, he stole his half-brother Apollo's herd of 50 sacred cattle from Pieria, cleverly reversing their hoofmarks by adding bark shoes to make it difficult to follow their tracks.

claims.statement: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to keep the herd (now 48, since he had sacrificed two) if he gave Apollo his lyre.
claims.statement_id: Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus, Hermes boleh menyimpan kawanan ternak (kini tinggal 48 karena dua telah ia korbankan) dengan syarat memberikan lira kepada Apollo.
claims.quote: After a hearing before Zeus and the Olympian gods, Hermes was permitted to hold on to the herd (now down to 48 as he had already sacrificed two of them) if he gave Apollo his lyre.

claims.statement: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on Zeus's orders to free Io.
claims.statement_id: Yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah pembunuhan monster bermata banyak (sebagian kisah menyebut 100 mata), Argos, atas perintah Zeus untuk membebaskan Io.
claims.quote: Perhaps most celebrated was his killing of the many-eyed (some accounts say 100-eyed) monster Argos on the orders of Zeus in order to free Io.

claims.statement: One of his most famous regular roles was leading souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu peran rutinnya yang termasyhur adalah menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx di dunia bawah, tempat juru perahu Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
claims.quote: One of his most famous regular roles was as a leader of souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

claims.statement: Another hero helped by Hermes was Perseus: Hermes gave him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guided him to the three Graeae who would reveal Medusa's location.
claims.statement_id: Pahlawan lain yang dibantu Hermes adalah Perseus: Hermes memberinya pedang atau sabit (harpe) adamantin yang tak patah dan menuntunnya ke tiga Graiai yang akan menunjukkan lokasi Medusa.
claims.quote: Another hero helped by the god was Perseus, Hermes giving him an unbreakable sword or sickle (harpe) of adamantine and guiding him to the three Graeae who would reveal the location of Medusa.

claims.statement: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long voyage home to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example by giving him an antidote to Circe's spells.
claims.statement_id: Hermes membantu Odiseus secara khusus, terutama pada pelayaran pulangnya yang panjang ke Ithaka (dalam Odyssey karya Homeros), misalnya dengan memberinya penawar mantra Kirke.
claims.quote: Hermes gives particular help to Odysseus, especially on his long return voyage to Ithaca (as told in Homer's Odyssey), for example, giving him an antidote to the spells of Circe.

claims.statement: Hermes was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often set up along roadsides as guides and to offer good fortune to passers-by.
claims.statement_id: Hermes adalah pelindung para pelancong, dan tugu batu (hermai) dengan lambang falus sering dipasang di tepi jalan sebagai penunjuk dan pembawa keberuntungan bagi yang lewat.
claims.quote: He was the patron of travellers, and stone pillars (hermae) with a phallus symbol were often to be seen set up along roadsides to act as guides and offer good fortune to those who passed.

claims.statement: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as herald), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally a lyre.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan memegang tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus (tanda perannya sebagai juru warta), bersandal bersayap (lambang perannya sebagai utusan), berjubah panjang atau kulit macan tutul, kadang bertopi bersayap (petasos), dan sesekali membawa lira.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Hermes is depicted holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as a herald, the stick is either cleft or with an open figure of 8 at the top), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as a messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes also a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally with a lyre.

claims.statement: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Hermes memiliki sejarah yang sangat panjang: ia disebut dalam lempeng Linear B peradaban Mykenai, yang mencapai puncaknya dari abad ke-15 hingga ke-13 SM.
claims.quote: Hermes has a very long history, being mentioned in the Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, at its height from the 15th to 13th century BCE.

claims.statement: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters, and even today the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.
claims.statement_id: Para orator menganggap dewa yang memindahkan kata dari pengirim ke penerima sebagai pelindung mereka, begitu pula para juru bahasa; hingga kini kajian dan penafsiran teks memakai namanya: hermeneutika.
claims.quote: Orators regarded the god who transferred words from sender to receiver as their patron, as did interpreters (another group of boundary-crossers) and, even today, the study and interpretation of texts carries his name: hermeneutics.

claims.statement: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, at one time or another stealing Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.
claims.statement_id: Hermes juga dikenal agak sebagai penipu cerdik, yang pada suatu waktu mencuri trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
claims.quote: Hermes was also known as something of a trickster, stealing at one time or another Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

claims.statement: Athens had one of the oldest cults of the god, where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.
claims.statement_id: Athena memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertua bagi Hermes, tempat festival Hermaia untuk anak laki-laki diadakan setiap tahun.
claims.quote: Athens had one of the oldest cults to the god where the Hermaia festival for young boys was held annually.

claims.statement: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.
claims.statement_id: Hermes juga membebaskan Ares dari penahanan setahun dalam kuali oleh raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes.
claims.quote: Hermes also freed Ares from his year-long imprisonment in a cauldron by the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes.

claims.statement: According to Theoi, as a newborn Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole Apollon's cattle, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell; Zeus was so amused that he granted him a place among the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theoi, sebagai bayi baru lahir Hermes menyelinap keluar dari buaian, mencuri ternak Apollon, dan membuat lira pertama dari tempurung kura-kura; Zeus begitu terhibur sehingga memberinya tempat sebagai satu dari dua belas dewa agung Olimpos.
claims.quote: As a new-born infant Hermes snuck out of his crib, stole the cattle of the god Apollon, and crafted the first lyre from a tortoise-shell. Zeus was so amused by the young god's antics that he granted him a place as one of the twelve supreme gods of Olympos.

claims.statement: Hermes turned the tell-tale herdsman Battos into stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.
claims.statement_id: Hermes mengubah gembala pembocor, Battos, menjadi batu sebagai hukuman karena melaporkan pencurian ternak Apollon.
claims.quote: Hermes transformed the tell-tale, herdsman Battos into a stone as punishment for reporting his theft of Apollon's cattle.

claims.statement: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus), though he was sometimes armed with a short sword instead.
claims.statement_id: Atribut Hermes yang paling khas adalah tongkat juru warta (kerykeion dalam bahasa Yunani, caduceus dalam bahasa Latin), tetapi kadang ia dipersenjatai pedang pendek.
claims.quote: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus) but he was sometimes armed instead with a short sword.

claims.statement: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare; in ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.
claims.statement_id: Hewan suci Hermes adalah domba jantan dan kelinci; dalam seni kuno ia menunggangi domba jantan besar.
claims.quote: Hermes' sacred animals were the ram and the hare. In ancient art he rode on the back of a large ram.

claims.statement: Homeric Hymn 4 says Zeus commanded that Hermes be lord over birds of omen, lions, boars, dogs, all flocks and all sheep, and the only appointed messenger to Hades.
claims.statement_id: Himne Homerik 4 menyatakan Zeus memerintahkan Hermes menjadi penguasa atas burung pertanda, singa, babi hutan, anjing, semua kawanan, dan semua domba, serta satu-satunya utusan yang ditunjuk ke Hades.
claims.quote: commanded that glorious Hermes should be lord over all birds of omen and grim-eyed lions, and boars with gleaming tusks, and over dogs and all flocks that the wide earth nourishes, and over all sheep; also that he only should be the appointed messenger to Hades

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, Hermes is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, olive cultivation, measures, weights, and many other things.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes dikatakan menciptakan alfabet, bilangan, astronomi, musik, seni bertarung, senam, budidaya zaitun, ukuran, timbangan, dan banyak hal lain.
claims.quote: he is said to have invented the alphabet, numbers, astronomy, music, the art of fighting, gymnastics, the cultivation of the olive tree, measures, weights, and many other things.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes had cunning in words and actions, even fraud, perjury, and an inclination to steal, but always committed with skill, dexterity, and gracefulness.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes memiliki kecerdikan dalam kata dan perbuatan, bahkan penipuan, sumpah palsu, dan kecenderungan mencuri, tetapi selalu dilakukan dengan keterampilan, kelincahan, dan keanggunan.
claims.quote: These qualities were combined with similar ones, such as cunning both in words and actions, and even fraud, perjury, and the inclination to steal; but acts of this kind were committed by Hermes always with a certain skill, dexterity, and even gracefulness.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes, a son of Zeus and Maia, the daughter of Atlas, was born in a cave of Mount Cyllene in Arcadia, but Philostratus places his birth in Olympus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes putra Zeus dan Maia, putri Atlas, lahir di gua di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia, tetapi Philostratos menempatkan kelahirannya di Olimpus.
claims.quote: a son of Zeus and Maia, the daughter of Atlas, was born in a cave of Mount Cyllene in Arcadia ... but Philostratus (Icon. i. 26) places his birth in Olympus.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Apollo gave Hermes his golden shepherd's staff and taught him prophesying by dice, and Zeus made him his own herald and herald of the gods of the lower world.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Apollo memberi Hermes tongkat gembala emasnya dan mengajarinya meramal dengan dadu, dan Zeus menjadikannya juru wartanya sendiri serta juru warta dewa-dewa dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Apollo presented his young friend with his own golden shepherd's staff, taught him the art of prophesying by means of dice, and Zeus made him his own herald, and also of the gods of the lower world.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, things sacred to Hermes included the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish, and offerings to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, hal-hal yang suci bagi Hermes mencakup pohon palem, kura-kura, angka empat, dan beberapa jenis ikan, dan kurban untuknya berupa kemenyan, madu, kue, babi, serta terutama domba dan anak kambing.
claims.quote: Among the things sacred to him we may mention the palm tree, the tortoise, the number four, and several kinds of fish; and the sacrifices offered to him consisted of incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

claims.statement: The name Hermes has long been derived from Greek herma ('stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.
claims.statement_id: Nama Hermes sejak lama diturunkan dari kata Yunani herma ('timbunan batu'), tetapi dugaan ilmiah ini juga diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: Hermes has long been derived from Greek ἕρμα (herma 'stone heap, cairn'), but this scholarly speculation is also disputed.

claims.statement: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek form written in the Linear B syllabic script.
claims.statement_id: Bentuk tertua nama Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam aksara silabis Linear B.
claims.quote: The earliest form of the name Hermes (Ἑρμῆς) is the Mycenaean Greek ... in the Linear B syllabic script.

claims.statement: According to a theory that has received considerable scholarly acceptance, Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan.
claims.statement_id: Menurut satu teori yang diterima cukup luas oleh para sarjana, Hermes berasal dari suatu bentuk dewa Pan.
claims.quote: According to a theory that has received considerable scholarly acceptance, Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan

claims.statement: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) that once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the site's archaeological museum.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Hermes dalam seni Yunani yang mungkin paling termasyhur adalah patung agung karya Praxiteles (sekitar 330 SM) yang dahulu berdiri di kuil Hera di Olimpia dan kini berada di museum arkeologi situs itu.
claims.quote: Perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art is the magnificent statue by Praxiteles (c. 330 BCE) which once stood in the temple of Hera at Olympia and now resides in the archaeological museum of the site.

claims.statement: In the Hellenistic period the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.
claims.statement_id: Pada periode Helenistik, Hermes sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium dan dipandang sebagai pelindung kaum muda.
claims.quote: In the Hellenistic period, the god was often associated with gymnasia and seen as the protector of youths.

claims.statement: In mythology Hermes was also the father of the pastoral god Pan and of Eudoros (with Polymele), a leader of the Myrmidons, although he was not given a wife in any Greek myth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi, Hermes juga ayah dewa gembala Pan dan Eudoros (dengan Polymele), salah satu pemimpin bangsa Myrmidon, meski ia tidak diberi istri dalam mitos Yunani mana pun.
claims.quote: In mythology, Hermes was also the father of the pastoral god Pan and Eudoros (with Polymele), one of the leaders of the Myrmidons, although the god was not given a wife in any Greek myth.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, other accounts place the theft of the oxen at a more advanced period of the god's life.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, kisah lain menempatkan pencurian ternak pada masa yang lebih lanjut dalam kehidupan sang dewa.
claims.quote: Other accounts, again, refer the theft of the oxen to a more advanced period of the life of the god.

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes's staff is frequently mentioned in the Homeric poems as the magic staff with which he closes and opens the eyes of mortals.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, tongkat Hermes sering disebut dalam puisi Homerik sebagai tongkat ajaib yang dengannya ia menutup dan membuka mata manusia.
claims.quote: it is frequently mentioned in the Homeric poems as the magic staff by means of which he closes and opens the eyes of mortals

claims.statement: According to the dictionary reproduced on Theoi, Hermes is also described as the god who had it in his power to send refreshing sleep or to take it away.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus yang dikutip Theoi, Hermes juga digambarkan sebagai dewa yang berkuasa mengirim tidur yang menyegarkan atau mencabutnya.
claims.quote: he is also described as the god who had it in his power to send refreshing sleep or to take it away.

claims.statement: Such tablets have been discovered at Pylos, Thebes, and Knossos.
claims.statement_id: Lempeng semacam itu ditemukan di Pylos, Thebes, dan Knossos.
claims.quote: Such tablets have been discovered at Pylos, Thebes, and Knossos.

claims.statement: Thor or Þórr is a hammer-bearing Germanic and Norse god linked to thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers.
claims.statement_id: Thor atau Þórr adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam tradisi Jermanik dan mitologi Nordik, terkait guntur, badai, kekuatan, perlindungan, kesuburan, dan petani.
claims.quote: Thor (from Old Norse: Þórr) is a prominent god in Germanic paganism. In Norse mythology, he is a hammer-wielding god associated with thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers.

claims.statement: Thor wields Mjölnir and wears Megingjörð and Járngreipr.
claims.statement_id: Thor menggunakan palu Mjölnir, sabuk Megingjörð, dan sarung tangan Járngreipr.
claims.quote: Thor wields the hammer Mjölnir, wears the belt Megingjörð and the iron gloves Járngreipr

claims.statement: Thor is described as defender of Asgard and Midgard, especially through fighting giants.
claims.statement_id: Thor digambarkan sebagai pembela Asgard dan Midgard, terutama dengan melawan para raksasa.
claims.quote: Thor was the defender of Asgard, realm of the gods, and Midgard, the human realm, and is primarily associated with protection through great feats of arms in slaying giants.

claims.statement: According to the National Museum of Denmark, Thor was the thunder god who protected Midgard with Mjöllnir.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Museum Nasional Denmark, Thor dewa guntur yang melindungi Midgard, dunia manusia, menggunakan Mjöllnir.
claims.quote: Thor was the god of thunder and he protected Midgard – the world of humans – using his hammer Mjöllnir.

claims.statement: The museum cites finds of Thor's hammers as archaeological evidence for early Viking beliefs.
claims.statement_id: Museum menyebut temuan benda berbentuk palu Thor sebagai bukti arkeologis kepercayaan awal Viking.
claims.quote: Apart from these sources, some archaeological objects have also been found, which tell us about the Vikings’ early beliefs and the pantheon of Norse gods. Thor’s hammers are a good example of this.

claims.statement: World History Encyclopedia calls Thor the Norse god of thunder, sky, and agriculture.
claims.statement_id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Thor dewa guntur, langit, dan pertanian Nordik.
claims.quote: Thor (Old Norse: Þórr) is the Norse god of thunder, the sky, and agriculture.

claims.statement: Thor is the son of Odin, chief of the gods, and Odin's consort Jord (Earth), and husband of the fertility goddess Sif, mother of his son Modi and daughter Thrud; his other son, Magni, may be from a union with the giantess Jarnsaxa.
claims.statement_id: Thor adalah putra Odin, pemimpin para dewa, dan Jord (Bumi), selir Odin, serta suami dewi kesuburan Sif, ibu putranya Modi dan putrinya Thrud; putranya yang lain, Magni, mungkin lahir dari hubungan dengan raksasi Jarnsaxa.
claims.quote: He is the son of Odin, chief of the gods, and Odin's consort Jord (Earth) and husband of the fertility goddess Sif, who is the mother of his son Modi and daughter Thrud; his other son, Magni, may be from a union with the giantess Jarnsaxa.

claims.statement: Most tales featuring Thor put him in conflict with a giant or with his nemesis the Midgard Serpent (Jörmungandr, the "huge monster"), a monstrous snake that coils around the world.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian besar kisah tentang Thor menempatkannya berhadapan dengan raksasa atau dengan musuh bebuyutannya, Ular Midgard (Jörmungandr, "monster besar"), ular raksasa yang melilit dunia.
claims.quote: The majority of the tales featuring Thor, in fact, put him in conflict with a giant or with his nemesis the Midgard Serpent (Jörmungandr, the "huge monster"), a monstrous snake who coils and twists itself around the world.

claims.statement: Like almost all Norse gods, Thor is doomed to die at Ragnarök, the end of the world and twilight of the gods, but falls only after killing the great serpent with his hammer Mjollnir, dying to its poison.
claims.statement_id: Seperti hampir semua dewa Nordik, Thor ditakdirkan tewas pada Ragnarök, akhir dunia dan senja para dewa, tetapi ia gugur hanya setelah membunuh ular raksasa dengan palunya Mjollnir dan mati karena bisanya.
claims.quote: Like almost all of the Norse gods, Thor is doomed to die at Ragnarök, the end of the world and twilight of the gods, but falls only after killing the great serpent with his powerful hammer Mjollnir, dying to its poison

claims.statement: Thor developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar and became the most popular deity of the Norse pantheon.
claims.statement_id: Thor berkembang dari dewa Germanik yang lebih awal, Donar, dan menjadi dewa paling populer dalam panteon Nordik.
claims.quote: He developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar and became the most popular deity of the Norse pantheon.

claims.statement: The modern English and German words for the fifth day of the week, Thursday and Donnerstag, both allude to Thor/Donar ("Thor's Day"/"Donar's Day").
claims.statement_id: Kata bahasa Inggris dan Jerman modern untuk hari kelima dalam sepekan, Thursday dan Donnerstag, sama-sama merujuk kepada Thor/Donar ("Hari Thor"/"Hari Donar").
claims.quote: the modern English and German words for the fifth day of the week - Thursday and Donnerstag - both allude to Thor/Donar ("Thor's Day"/"Donar's Day").

claims.statement: Thor was thought to have ruled the sky from his land of Þrúðvangr ("Power-Field" or "Plains of Strength"), where he built his great hall Bilskírnir, a palace of 540 rooms.
claims.statement_id: Thor dipercaya memerintah langit dari tanahnya, Þrúðvangr ("Ladang Kuasa" atau "Dataran Kekuatan"), tempat ia membangun aula besarnya, Bilskírnir, istana berkamar 540.
claims.quote: He was thought to have ruled the sky from his land of Þrúðvangr ("Power-Field" or "Plains of Strength") where he built his great hall of Bilskírnir, a palace of 540 rooms.

claims.statement: Thor was said to burst forth from his hall in a chariot drawn by two male goats, Tanngnjóstr (Tooth Gnasher) and Tanngrísnir (Snarl Tooth), which he could kill and eat and bring back to life the next day as long as their bones stayed unbroken.
claims.statement_id: Thor dikisahkan keluar dari aula besarnya dengan kereta yang ditarik dua kambing jantan, Tanngnjóstr (Penggertak Gigi) dan Tanngrísnir (Gigi Menggeram), yang dapat dibunuh dan dimakan lalu dihidupkan kembali keesokan harinya selama tulangnya tidak patah.
claims.quote: He was said to burst forth from his great hall in his chariot, drawn by two male goats - Tanngnjóstr (Tooth Gnasher) and Tanngrísnir (Snarl Tooth) - who could be killed and eaten by the god and then brought back to life the next day as long as their bones remained unbroken.

claims.statement: The roar of thunder was the rumble of Thor's chariot wheels across the vault of the heavens, and in another story he is credited with creating tides.
claims.statement_id: Gemuruh guntur adalah deru roda kereta Thor di kubah langit, dan dalam kisah lain ia dianggap menciptakan pasang surut.
claims.quote: The roar of thunder was the rumble of Thor's chariot's wheels across the vault of the heavens and, in another story, he is credited with creating tides.

claims.statement: Thor's popularity reached its height in the Viking Age (c. 790-1100), when he was considered the greatest rival to Christ as Christianity was introduced to Scandinavia from roughly the 10th century.
claims.statement_id: Popularitas Thor mencapai puncaknya pada Zaman Viking (sekitar 790-1100), ketika ia dianggap saingan terbesar Kristus saat agama Kristen mulai diperkenalkan ke Skandinavia kira-kira dari abad ke-10.
claims.quote: Thor's popularity reached its height during the Viking Age (c. 790-1100) at which time he was considered the greatest rival to Christ when, roughly from the 10th century onwards, Christianity was introduced to Scandinavia.

claims.statement: More amulets and charms of Thor's hammer date from the period when Christianity and the Norse religion were in contention than from any other.
claims.statement_id: Lebih banyak jimat palu Thor berasal dari masa ketika agama Kristen dan agama Nordik bersaing daripada dari masa lain mana pun.
claims.quote: More amulets and charms of Thor's hammer date from the period when Christianity and the Norse religion were in contention than from any other.

claims.statement: Thor had three magical items that helped him defend Asgard and Midgard: his hammer Mjollnir, his belt of strength Megingjörð (which doubled his strength when worn), and the great iron gloves he needed to wield the hammer.
claims.statement_id: Thor memiliki tiga benda ajaib yang membantunya membela Asgard dan Midgard: palu Mjollnir, sabuk kekuatan Megingjörð (yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya saat dikenakan), dan sarung tangan besi besar yang diperlukan untuk memegang palunya.
claims.quote: He had three magical items which helped him defend Asgard and Midgard: his hammer Mjollnir, his belt of strength Megingjörð (which doubled his strength when he wore it), and his great iron gloves which he needed to wield his hammer.

claims.statement: Thor was invoked to seal business contracts and consecrate marriages, for agricultural abundance, for protection on voyages (especially at sea) and for victory in battle, and seems to have been called upon whenever any need arose.
claims.statement_id: Thor diseru untuk mengesahkan kontrak dagang dan memberkati pernikahan, demi kelimpahan pertanian, perlindungan dalam pelayaran (terutama di laut), dan kemenangan perang, tetapi tampaknya ia dipanggil kapan pun kebutuhan muncul.
claims.quote: Thor was invoked to seal business contracts and consecrate marriages, for agricultural abundance, for protection during voyages (especially at sea) and for victory in battle, but he seems to have been called upon whenever any need arose.

claims.statement: These items embellish Thor's great strength, his main feature, and Thor also has a quick temper and shows impatience with following others' rules.
claims.statement_id: Benda-benda itu menambah kekuatan besar Thor, yang menjadi ciri utamanya; Thor juga cepat naik darah dan tidak sabar mengikuti aturan orang lain.
claims.quote: These items embellish Thor's great strength, which is his main feature, and Thor also has a quick temper and shows impatience for following others' rules.

claims.statement: Thor is completely without guile or the capacity to deceive and so cannot recognize these qualities in others; as a result he is often tricked by magical spells or shape-shifting entities that make things appear other than they are.
claims.statement_id: Thor sama sekali tidak berlicik dan tidak mampu menipu sehingga tak dapat mengenali sifat itu pada orang lain; akibatnya ia sering dikelabui mantra atau makhluk pengubah wujud yang membuat segala sesuatu tampak lain dari kenyataan.
claims.quote: Thor is completely without guile or the capacity to deceive and so cannot recognize these qualities in others; as a result, he is often tricked by magical spells or shape-shifting entities which cause things to appear other than they are.

claims.statement: Contrary to the popular present-day image from Marvel comics and films, Thor was not Loki's brother and is never depicted as clean-shaven or blonde except in chapter 3 of the Prose Edda (composed c. 1220), written from a Christian context by the Icelander Snorri Sturluson.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dari citra populer masa kini dari komik dan film Marvel, Thor bukan saudara Loki dan tidak pernah digambarkan klimis atau berambut pirang kecuali dalam bab 3 Prose Edda (disusun sekitar 1220), karya yang ditulis dari konteks Kristen oleh Snorri Sturluson dari Islandia.
claims.quote: he was not the brother of Loki and is never depicted as clean-shaven or blonde-haired except in chapter 3 of the Prose Edda (composed c. 1220), a mythography of earlier Norse myths reworked by the Icelander Snorri Sturluson into one structured account, written from a Christian context.

claims.statement: Elsewhere, and in almost every image, Thor is shown with long red hair and a great beard, often leaping into battle against giants or killing dwarves without considering alternatives to violence.
claims.statement_id: Di tempat lain dan dalam hampir setiap gambar, Thor selalu ditampilkan berambut merah panjang dan berjanggut lebat, sering melompat ke pertempuran melawan raksasa atau membunuh kurcaci tanpa mempertimbangkan alternatif selain kekerasan.
claims.quote: Elsewhere, and in almost every image, Thor is always shown with long red hair and a great beard, often as not leaping into battle against giants or killing dwarves without pausing to consider alternatives to violence.

claims.statement: Utgarda-Loki reveals that he was Skrýmir in the forest and deceived Thor each time Thor struck him; Thor was actually striking mountains whose tops were leveled by each blow.
claims.statement_id: Utgarda-Loki mengungkapkan bahwa ia adalah Skrýmir di hutan dan telah mengelabui Thor setiap kali Thor memukulnya; Thor sebenarnya memukul gunung-gunung yang puncaknya kini rata oleh tiap pukulan.
claims.quote: He first tells them that he was Skrýmir in the forest and that he deceived Thor each time Thor struck him; Thor was actually striking at mountains whose tops were now leveled from each blow.

claims.statement: Utgarda-Loki explains that the bottom of the drinking horn was in the sea, so Thor could never have emptied it, but he drank so much that the sea level dropped and Thor created tides.
claims.statement_id: Utgarda-Loki menjelaskan bahwa dasar tanduk minum itu berada di laut sehingga Thor tak akan pernah bisa mengosongkannya, tetapi Thor meminum sedemikian banyak hingga permukaan laut turun dan ia menciptakan pasang surut.
claims.quote: In the case of Thor's contest, Utgarda-Loki explains, the bottom of the drinking horn was in the sea so that, no matter how much Thor drank, he would never have been able to empty it. He did manage to drink so much, however, that the sea level had dropped and Thor had now created tides.

claims.statement: In another popular tale, Thor's hammer is stolen by the giants and he must disguise himself as the goddess Freyja and pretend to be the giant's bride to get it back.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah populer lain, palu Thor dicuri para raksasa dan ia harus menyamar sebagai dewi Freyja dan berpura-pura menjadi pengantin sang raksasa untuk mendapatkannya kembali.
claims.quote: In another popular tale, Thor's hammer is stolen by the giants and he must disguise himself as the goddess Freyja and pretend to be the giant's bride in order to get it back.

claims.statement: Shortly afterwards Thor goes fishing with the giant Hymir and catches the serpent, but Hymir, fearful of drowning because the fight threatens their boat, cuts the line.
claims.statement_id: Tak lama kemudian Thor memancing bersama raksasa Hymir dan menangkap ular itu, tetapi Hymir, takut tenggelam karena pertarungan Thor mengancam perahu mereka, memotong tali pancing.
claims.quote: Shortly afterwards, he goes fishing with the giant Hymir and catches the serpent but Hymir, fearful of drowning since Thor's fight with the beast is threatening their boat, cuts the line.

claims.statement: The scholar Preben Meulengracht Sørensen, quoted by World History Encyclopedia, says Thor was master of thunder and lightning, storm and rain, fair weather and crops, and the pagans sacrificed to him when threatened by hunger or disease.
claims.statement_id: Sarjana Preben Meulengracht Sørensen, yang dikutip World History Encyclopedia, menyebut Thor penguasa guntur dan kilat, badai dan hujan, cuaca cerah dan panen, dan bahwa kaum pagan berkurban kepadanya saat terancam kelaparan atau penyakit.
claims.quote: was master of thunder and lightning, storm and rain, fair weather and crops, and the pagans sacrificed to him when threatened by hunger or disease

claims.statement: Christianity finally prevailed and the cult of Thor was gradually replaced by the new religion by the 12th century.
claims.statement_id: Agama Kristen akhirnya menang dan pemujaan Thor berangsur digantikan agama baru itu pada abad ke-12.
claims.quote: Christianity finally prevailed and the cult of Thor was gradually replaced by the new religion by the 12th century.

claims.statement: Thor is closely associated with water in many myths and is depicted rowing out further into the sea than others and crossing dangerous rivers.
claims.statement_id: Thor dikaitkan erat dengan air dalam banyak mitos dan digambarkan mendayung ke laut lebih jauh daripada yang lain serta menyeberangi sungai berbahaya.
claims.quote: He is closely associated with water in many of the myths and is depicted rowing out further into the sea than others have gone and also crossing dangerous rivers

claims.statement: Thor functioned primarily as a protector-god, although stories about him also explained natural phenomena.
claims.statement_id: Thor terutama berfungsi sebagai dewa pelindung, meski kisah-kisah tentangnya juga menjelaskan gejala alam.
claims.quote: Thor functioned primarily as a protector-god, although stories concerning him also explained natural phenomena

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Har says Thor is the strongest of all gods and men and rules the realm called Thrudvang; his hall is called Bilskirner.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, Har menyebut Thor yang terkuat di antara semua dewa dan manusia; ia memerintah wilayah bernama Thrudvang dan aulanya bernama Bilskirner.
claims.quote: He is the strongest of all gods and men, and rules over the realm which is called Thrudvang. His hall is called Bilskirner.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Thor has two goats named Tangnjost and Tangrisner and a chariot, and the goats draw the chariot.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor memiliki dua kambing bernama Tangnjost dan Tangrisner serta sebuah kereta; kambing-kambing itu menarik keretanya.
claims.quote: Thor has two goats, by name Tangnjost and Tangrisner, and a chariot, wherein he drives. The goats draw the chariot

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, the hammer Mjolner is well known to the frost-giants and mountain-giants when raised, for with it Thor has split many a skull of their fathers or friends.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, palu Mjolner dikenal baik oleh raksasa es dan raksasa gunung ketika diangkat, karena dengannya Thor telah membelah banyak tengkorak ayah atau kawan mereka.
claims.quote: One of them is the hammer Mjolner, which the frost-giants and mountain-giants well know when it is raised; and this is not to be wondered at, for with it he has split many a skull of their fathers or friends.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Thor's second treasure is Megingjarder (belt of strength), which doubles his strength when worn, and his third is his iron gloves, which he cannot do without when he grips the hammer's haft.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, harta kedua Thor adalah Megingjarder (sabuk kekuatan) yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya saat dikenakan, dan harta ketiganya sarung tangan besi yang tak dapat ia tinggalkan saat menggenggam gagang palu.
claims.quote: The second treasure he possesses is Megingjarder (belt of strength); when he girds himself with it his strength is doubled. His third treasure that is of so great value is his iron gloves; these he cannot do without when he lays hold of the hammer's haft.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Thor takes the largest of Hymer's oxen, called Himinbrjot, twists its head off, and brings it down to the sea-strand.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor mengambil lembu terbesar milik Hymer, bernama Himinbrjot, memelintir kepalanya hingga putus, dan membawanya ke pantai.
claims.quote: Then Thor turned away to where he saw a herd of oxen, that belonged to Hymer. He took the largest ox, which was called Himinbrjot, twisted his head off and brought it down to the sea-strand.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Thor pulls the serpent up to the gunwale, and no one has ever seen a more terrible sight than Thor fixing his eyes on the serpent as it stared back and spouted venom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor menarik ular itu hingga ke tepi perahu, dan tak pernah ada pemandangan lebih mengerikan daripada saat Thor menatap ular itu dan ular itu menatapnya sambil menyemburkan bisa.
claims.quote: He pulled the serpent up to the gunwale; and in truth no one has ever seen a more terrible sight than when Thor whet his eyes on the serpent, and the latter stared at him and spouted venom.
